stage1.impression: A terraced ring lamp glows on a dark desk at dusk, but the ball is one clipped red slab whose terraces only show at the rim, and the black base dissolves into the table. The light is meant to be the subject, yet it barely touches the table or the wall, and the pinkish page block of the books is the brightest thing outside the product.

duel.why: B reads as a real photograph: the orb's red glow pools across the table, lights the wall and picks out the book edges ... A is the more ownable object, a stepped stack of glowing rings, but its flat, oversaturated red, its centred catalogue framing and the uneven ring seams make it read as CG, and its light does almost nothing to the room.
